title: Oracle 19c broker validation contract
description: Broker-produced description of a provisioned RDS Oracle 19c instance, consumed by cg-oracle-database-19c-stig-overlay to run + layer STIG validation (epic #519, WS12/13 #530, ADR-0002). MUST NOT contain secrets: no plaintext passwords, AWS secret keys, admin credentials, or customer data. Credentials are referenced by opaque ref only.

environment.description: Lets the overlay distinguish local dev signal from real RDS evidence (ADR-0005).

engine.description: Standard Edition 2. Enterprise Edition (oracle-ee) is not offered — License Included is SE2-only on RDS (ADR-0004).

endpoint.description: RDS endpoint host (or tunnel host for the overlay). Not a secret.

port.description: DB listener port. The SSL/TCPS listener is 2484 when ssl_enabled; the plaintext default is 1521.

protocol.description: Listener protocol: tcps for the TLS listener, tcp for plaintext.

ssl_enabled.description: Whether the RDS Oracle SSL option group (encryption-in-transit) is provisioned. Reflects configured posture; TLS-only reachability depends on the platform security group (#541).

ssl_version.description: Negotiated/configured TLS version. RDS Oracle SSL supports 1.2 only.

kms_key_id.description: KMS key ARN/id used for encryption at rest. An identifier, not key material.

assessment_credential_ref.description: OPAQUE reference (e.g. binding GUID / secret-store path) the operator resolves out-of-band to obtain the assessment DB credential. NEVER the credential itself.

app_credential_ref.description: OPAQUE reference to the application binding credential. NEVER the credential itself.

$comment: Forbidden keys (enforced by tests, not schema): password, master_password, master_username, aws_secret_access_key, secret_access_key, admin_password. The renderer must fail closed if any appear.
